priority.disposition: preserve compatibility redirect; no UI redesign or shared component needed
priority.rationale: This mounted legacy surface is intentionally nonvisual. Replacing it with an invented page would violate mission section 0 preservation and MDC-030 route/alias obligations.

competingImplementations.classification: compatibility alias, not a competing rules page
competingImplementations.limit: No repository-wide duplication audit was performed. The scoped route registrations establish this shim and its target, not the absence of all other implementations.

dataBehavior: Read search and hash directly from useLocation; concatenate them in search-then-hash order.
Do not parse, decode, re-encode, reorder, whitelist or rename query parameters in this shim.
Preserve the incoming hash string; do not claim this alone proves an anchor exists or scrolls correctly.
Keep the fixed internal canonical pathname and replace semantics.
Keep the /alert-rules mount, lazy import and canonical /notifications/rules registration.
No hooks fetching API data, endpoints, mutation actions, SI fields, display conversions, query caches, exports or persisted preferences exist locally.

compatibility.query: All router-provided search text is forwarded unchanged by module code, including unrecognized names and encoded values.
compatibility.hash: Router-provided hash text is forwarded unchanged after search.
compatibility.historyState: Not read or explicitly forwarded: useLocation destructures only search/hash and Navigate receives no state prop. Do not claim location.state preservation.
compatibility.pathname: Legacy pathname is replaced with the fixed canonical pathname; no wildcard or path-parameter translation is implemented.

destinationQueryBoundary.detail: The narrowly inspected destination editor selector reads searchParams.get('rule'). Existing redirect tests use rule_id as an opaque forwarded parameter, not as proof that rule_id selects an editor.
destinationQueryBoundary.classification: semantic compatibility limit, not an established redirect bug
destinationQueryBoundary.preserve: Do not invent rule_id-to-rule translation or assert support for unknown legacy parameter semantics; historical producer requirements and downstream behavior remain unverified.

replace history entry; Back returns to /start
